name: Wishlist Bot
description: Production-only evlog telemetry from the Wishlist Cloudflare Worker: ingest and Telegram update health, scheduled work and releases, audience, languages, and wish, give, search and share activity. Aggregate metrics only; no user identities leave D1.

pages.name: Production
pages.description: All widgets filter New Relic EU account 8569908 to the production Wishlist service.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Events' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' SINCE 15 minutes ago

SELECT count(*) AS 'Failures' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'telegram_webhook_completed' AND outcome IN ('error', 'rejected') SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT percentile(elapsedMs, 95) AS 'p95 ms' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'telegram_webhook_completed' SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' TIMESERIES
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'telegram_webhook_completed' FACET outcome TIMESERIES
SELECT percentile(elapsedMs, 50, 95) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'telegram_webhook_completed' TIMESERIES
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'telegram_webhook_completed' FACET idempotencyOutcome LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'telegram_webhook_completed' AND outcome = 'rejected' FACET rejectionReason LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND (outcome = 'error' OR eventName LIKE '%failed' OR eventName LIKE '%_error' OR eventName = 'telegram_update_lease_lost') FACET eventName LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName IN ('scheduled_run_completed', 'scheduled_run_failed') FACET eventName TIMESERIES
SELECT percentile(elapsedMs, 95) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'scheduled_run_completed' FACET cron TIMESERIES

SELECT latest(candidates) AS 'Candidates', latest(inserted) AS 'Created', latest(enqueued) AS 'Queued' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'release_broadcast_completed' FACET releaseVersion LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName IN ('release_announcement_failed', 'release_announcement_handler_error', 'release_announcement_state_write_failed', 'release_announcement_ambiguous', 'release_announcement_rate_limited', 'release_announcement_invalid_job', 'release_announcement_stale_job', 'release_announcement_notes_missing', 'release_announcement_queue_batch_failed') FACET eventName LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action = 'wish_created' TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 7 days ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'telegram_webhook_completed' AND outcome = 'accepted' FACET updateType, commandCategory LIMIT 20

SELECT count(*) AS 'All requests', filter(count(*), WHERE status >= 500) AS 'HTTP 5xx' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'http_request_completed' TIMESERIES

pages.name: Audience
pages.description: Latest D1 snapshot: registered, blocked and active users, languages and wish totals.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(registeredUsers) AS 'Registered' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_state_snapshot' SINCE 2 hours ago
SELECT latest(blockedUsers) AS 'Blocked' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_state_snapshot' SINCE 2 hours ago
SELECT latest(activeUsers1d) AS 'Active 1d' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_state_snapshot' SINCE 2 hours ago
SELECT latest(activeUsers7d) AS 'Active 7d' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_state_snapshot' SINCE 2 hours ago
SELECT latest(activeUsers30d) AS 'Active 30d' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_state_snapshot' SINCE 2 hours ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Snapshots' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_state_snapshot' SINCE 1 hour ago

SELECT latest(registeredUsers) AS 'Registered', latest(blockedUsers) AS 'Blocked' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_state_snapshot' TIMESERIES SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT latest(activeUsers1d) AS '1 day', latest(activeUsers7d) AS '7 days', latest(activeUsers30d) AS '30 days' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_state_snapshot' TIMESERIES SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT latest(languageCount) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'user_language_count' FACET locale SINCE 2 hours ago LIMIT 4

SELECT latest(languageCount) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'user_language_count' FACET locale TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT latest(totalWishes) AS 'All time', latest(activeWishes) AS 'Active', latest(doneWishes) AS 'Done' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_state_snapshot' TIMESERIES SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT latest(hiddenWishes) AS 'Hidden', latest(priorityWishes) AS 'Priority', latest(gives) AS 'Gives' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_state_snapshot' TIMESERIES SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT latest(usersWithPayments) AS 'With payments' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_state_snapshot' SINCE 2 hours ago

SELECT count(*) AS 'Registrations' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action = 'user_registered' SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action = 'user_registered' TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago

pages.name: Actions
pages.description: Completed bot actions and navigation from the last 30 days.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Created' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action = 'wish_created' SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Updated' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action = 'wish_updated' SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Removed' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action = 'wish_removed' SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) AS 'Gives added' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action = 'give_added' SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) AS 'Gives removed' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action = 'give_removed' SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) AS 'Feedback' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action = 'feedback_sent' SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action IN ('wish_created', 'wish_updated', 'wish_removed') FACET action TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action = 'wish_updated' FACET field SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action = 'wish_removed' FACET result SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action = 'wishlist_searched' FACET result SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Gives added and removed per day

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action IN ('give_added', 'give_removed', 'give_list_cleaned') FACET action TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action = 'wishlist_shared' FACET result SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'telegram_webhook_completed' AND outcome = 'accepted' AND updateType = 'callback_query' FACET callbackCategory SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 40

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'telegram_webhook_completed' AND outcome = 'accepted' AND callbackCategory IN ('wishlist:page', 'third:page', 'give:page') FACET callbackCategory TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Filters, language and visibility changes per day

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action IN ('wishlist_filtered', 'language_changed', 'visibility_changed') FACET action TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Payments updated and removed per day

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND action IN ('payments_updated', 'payments_removed') FACET action TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'telegram_webhook_completed' AND outcome = 'accepted' FACET updateType SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 5

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'telegram_webhook_completed' AND outcome = 'accepted' AND commandCategory NOT IN ('nonCommand', 'message', 'contact', 'photo', 'notParsed') FACET commandCategory SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 15

pages.name: Share pages
pages.description: Public share pages on wishlist.chernenko.dev in the production Wishlist service. Share page ids never appear in telemetry.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Views' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'share_page_served' AND result IN ('rendered', 'cached', 'notModified') SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE cacheOutcome = 'hit') AS 'Hit ratio' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'share_page_served' AND result IN ('rendered', 'cached', 'notModified') SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Errors' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'share_page_served' AND result = 'error' SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'share_page_served' FACET result TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Latency p50 / p95 by cache outcome (ms)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(elapsedMs, 50, 95) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'share_page_served' AND result IN ('rendered', 'cached') FACET cacheOutcome TIMESERIES SINCE 7 days ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'share_page_served' AND result IN ('rendered', 'cached', 'notModified') FACET locale SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 4

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'share_page_served' AND result IN ('notFound', 'gone') FACET result TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Published, stopped and rotated per day

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' AND (action IN ('wishlist_share_stopped', 'wishlist_share_rotated') OR (action = 'wishlist_shared' AND result = 'published')) FACET action TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago

pages.name: Mini App
pages.description: Telegram Mini App (/app, /api/app, /img) in the production Wishlist service. Events carry closed labels only: no initData, Telegram ids, wish ids, public ids, queries or text.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Sessions' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'app_session_started' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS '5xx' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'app_api_completed' AND status >= 500 SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Rate limited' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'app_rate_limited' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'app_session_started' FACET platform TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'app_session_started' FACET startKind SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 10

widgets.title: API requests by route and status

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'app_api_completed' FACET route, status SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 50

widgets.title: API latency p50 / p95 by route (ms)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(elapsedMs, 50, 95) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'app_api_completed' FACET route SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 50

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'app_api_completed' AND status >= 500 FACET route TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'app_auth_rejected' FACET reason SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'app_rate_limited' FACET bucket SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'app_rate_limiter_missing' FACET bucket, result SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS 'Actions' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'bot_action_completed' FACET channel, action SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 50
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'app_photo_uploaded' FACET result SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Image proxy hit ratio by scope

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE result = 'hit') AS 'Hit ratio' FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'image_proxy_served' FACET scope SINCE 7 days ago

widgets.title: Image proxy latency p50 / p95 by scope (ms)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(elapsedMs, 50, 95) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'image_proxy_served' FACET scope TIMESERIES SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'image_proxy_served' FACET result TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_wishlist WHERE `service.name` = 'wishlist' AND botEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'app_client_event' FACET kind, screen SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 20
